title: Volcanoes of Oceania (hot and cold)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Oceania, one after another. You have three tries for each place and are told warmer or colder after a miss. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Hunga Tonga-Hunga Ha'apai
rounds.fact: Hunga Tonga-Hunga Ha'apai is a submarine volcano; the latest significant eruption recorded for it in the source data was in 2022. The data places it in Tonga.
